func (w *TraceWindow) Bytes() int

func (w *TraceWindow) ChildStepOf(intent uint64) (TraceStep, bool)

func (w *TraceWindow) Cursor() TraceCursor

func (w *TraceWindow) First() uint64

func (w *TraceWindow) Last() uint64

func (w *TraceWindow) MoreBefore() bool

func (w *TraceWindow) NativeID() string

func (w *TraceWindow) Records() int

func (w *TraceWindow) Reset(chunk TraceChunk)

func (w *TraceWindow) Step(id string) (TraceStep, bool)

func (w *TraceWindow) StepAt(sequence uint64) (TraceStep, bool)

func (w *TraceWindow) Steps() []TraceStep

func (w *TraceWindow) Trim(atEnd bool)

func (w *TraceWindow) Unsupported() bool

func (w *TranscriptWindow) ApplyNewer(chunk TranscriptChunk)

func (w *TranscriptWindow) ApplyOlder(chunk TranscriptChunk)

func (w *TranscriptWindow) Blocks() []Block

func (w *TranscriptWindow) First() uint64

func (w *TranscriptWindow) Last() uint64

func (w *TranscriptWindow) MoreAfter() bool

func (w *TranscriptWindow) MoreBefore() bool

func (w *TranscriptWindow) Reset(chunk TranscriptChunk)

func (w *TranscriptWindow) Trim(atEnd bool)

func ActiveBranch(detail hub.Detail) (hub.Branch, error)

func LayoutTrace(steps []TraceStep, scale TraceScale) TraceLayout

type AutomationCoordinator struct {
	Store hub.AutomationStore
}

type Block struct {
	ID              string
	Kind            BlockKind
	SessionID       string
	TurnID          string
	AttemptID       string
	Turn            uint64
	Status          BlockStatus
	Name            string
	Text            string
	Truncated       bool
	Ref             *engine.Reference
	NativeSessionID string
	HandoffID       string

	History uint64

	Tool *ToolView

	Interaction *InteractionView

	Usage *engine.Usage
}

type BlockKind string

type BlockStatus string

type ChildHop struct {
	LinkSequence uint64 `json:"link_sequence"`
}

type CompanionRoundReview struct {
	Round   hub.CompanionRound
	Wait    *WaitView
	Problem string
}

type CompanionService struct {
}

type ComposerArgument struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Label    string `json:"label"`
	Required bool   `json:"required"`
	MaxBytes int    `json:"max_bytes"`
}

type ComposerCatalogEntry struct {
	ID                string             `json:"id"`
	Kind              ComposerEntryKind  `json:"kind"`
	Name              string             `json:"name"`
	Description       string             `json:"description"`
	Origin            string             `json:"origin"`
	Scope             string             `json:"scope"`
	Source            string             `json:"source,omitempty"`
	Available         bool               `json:"available"`
	UnavailableReason string             `json:"unavailable_reason,omitempty"`
	Arguments         []ComposerArgument `json:"arguments"`
}

type ComposerCatalogPage struct {
	Entries []ComposerCatalogEntry `json:"entries"`
	Total   int                    `json:"total"`
	Offset  int                    `json:"offset"`
	Limit   int                    `json:"limit"`
}

type ComposerCatalogQuery struct {
	Kind   ComposerEntryKind `json:"kind,omitempty"`
	Search string            `json:"search,omitempty"`
	Offset int               `json:"offset,omitempty"`
	Limit  int               `json:"limit,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerDraftsService struct {
}

type ComposerEntryDetail struct {
	Entry    ComposerCatalogEntry `json:"entry"`
	Document *skill.Document      `json:"document,omitempty"`
	SHA256   string               `json:"sha256,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerEntryKind string

type ComposerFileCandidate struct {
	Path        string                 `json:"path"`
	Name        string                 `json:"name"`
	Kind        string                 `json:"kind"`
	DisplayPath string                 `json:"display_path"`
	Bytes       int64                  `json:"bytes"`
	Revision    string                 `json:"revision"`
	Captured    *ComposerFileSelection `json:"captured,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerFileCandidatePage struct {
	Entries   []ComposerFileCandidate `json:"entries"`
	Scanned   int                     `json:"scanned"`
	Truncated bool                    `json:"truncated"`
}

type ComposerFileManifest struct {
	Selection     ComposerFileSelection `json:"selection"`
	Info          storage.ArtifactInfo  `json:"info"`
	Reference     wire.Reference        `json:"reference"`
	TextReference *wire.Reference       `json:"text_reference,omitempty"`
	InlineText    string                `json:"inline_text,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerFileSearch struct {
	Offset int64  `json:"offset"`
	Text   string `json:"text"`
}

type ComposerFileSearchPage struct {
	Matches    []ComposerFileSearch `json:"matches"`
	Scanned    int64                `json:"scanned"`
	NextOffset int64                `json:"next_offset"`
	Truncated  bool                 `json:"truncated"`
}

type ComposerFileSelection struct {
	Scope  hub.ComposerDraftScope `json:"scope"`
	ID     string                 `json:"id"`
	SHA256 string                 `json:"sha256"`
}

type ComposerGoalReference struct {
	GoalID    string               `json:"goal_id"`
	Revision  uint64               `json:"revision"`
	Scope     hub.GoalScope        `json:"scope"`
	SessionID string               `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
	BranchID  string               `json:"branch_id,omitempty"`
	Info      storage.ArtifactInfo `json:"info"`
	Reference wire.Reference       `json:"reference"`
}

type ComposerIntent string

type ComposerPreparation struct {
	EntryID   string                  `json:"entry_id"`
	Kind      ComposerEntryKind       `json:"kind"`
	Origin    string                  `json:"origin"`
	Scope     string                  `json:"scope"`
	Arguments map[string]string       `json:"arguments,omitempty"`
	Intent    ComposerIntent          `json:"intent,omitempty"`
	Text      string                  `json:"text"`
	SkillRef  *ComposerSkillReference `json:"skill_ref,omitempty"`
	GoalRef   *ComposerGoalReference  `json:"goal_ref,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerSelectionRequest struct {
	EntryID   string            `json:"entry_id"`
	Arguments map[string]string `json:"arguments,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerSkillReference struct {
	Workspace    string       `json:"workspace,omitempty"`
	SessionID    string       `json:"session_id"`
	BranchID     string       `json:"branch_id"`
	Name         string       `json:"name"`
	RelativePath string       `json:"relative_path"`
	SHA256       string       `json:"sha256"`
	Policy       skill.Policy `json:"policy"`
}

type ConnectionCatalog struct {

type GoalArtifacts interface {
	Create(context.Context, string, string, string) (storage.Session, error)
	PutArtifact(context.Context, string, string, storage.ArtifactInput) (storage.ArtifactInfo, error)
	ReadArtifactFull(context.Context, string, string, string, int) (storage.ArtifactInfo, []byte, error)
}

	Detail(context.Context, string) (hub.Detail, error)
}

	Store               ServiceStore

	Approvals           *host.ApprovalBroker

	Gateway             *gateway.Local
	Developer           *developer.Service
	Preferences         *PreferencesService
	ComposerDrafts      *ComposerDraftsService
	Documents           *document.Processor
	Connections         *ConnectionsService

	Companions          *CompanionService
	WorkspaceViews      *WorkspaceViewsService
	DeveloperWorkspaces *DeveloperWorkspacesService
	ConversationTabs    *ConversationTabsService
	Teams               *TeamCoordinator
	Automations         *AutomationCoordinator
	Worktrees           *worktree.Manager
	Shells              *shell.Sessions

	Transcripts *TranscriptService

	Traces *TraceService
}

	CanSkip bool

	ID, Header, Text string
	Options          []string

}

	Answers map[string]InteractionAnswer

	Kind  InteractionKind

	Answers   []InteractionAnswer

	Truncated bool
}

	X0, X1 float32

	Unsupported           bool

	First, Last, HighWater uint64

	StepID string

	NativeID  string
	ChildID   string

	Error     string
	Arguments string
	Result    string
	Message   string

}

}

	Turn    uint64
	History uint64
}

	Sequence uint64
	Kind     string
	Type     string

	Time     time.Time
}

	Bars     []TraceBar
	Groups   []TraceGroup
	From, To time.Time
}

	Sequence uint64
	Role     string

	URI      string
	Bytes    int64
	Time     time.Time

}

	Start, End   time.Time
	Approximate  bool
	Open         bool

	RequestID    string
	RunID        string
	CallID       string

	ChildLink uint64

}

	Kind        string `json:"kind"`

}

var ErrRouteUnavailable = errors.New("route changed or is unavailable; select a current configured route")

var ErrWorkspaceReferenceChanged = errors.New("workspace selection changed; search and select it again")
